# Overview of Session 2 {#sec-s2}

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
## Coming soon
This session's chapters are being written. The plan is below.
:::

**Theme:** Equations, finding the number you need. How many units until you break even? What price reaches your profit target?

**Planned chapters:** what an equation is; solving linear equations; rearranging a formula; quadratic equations, the quadratic formula and the discriminant; your business: break-even; practice; catch-up sheet.

**Further reading (optional):** @olivier2023, sec. 2.5, pp. 46–56, and sec. 5.2, pp. 157–164; @stitz2013, sec. 2.3, pp. 188–207; @mazur2021, sec. 2.1–2.5, pp. 167–270. In German: @gundlach2024, sec. 1.3, pp. 21–22.
